SELECT provider.provider_id AS providerId, provider.provider_code AS providerCode, project_map.mapping_id AS projectMappingId, session_map.mapping_id AS sessionMappingId, sku_map.mapping_id AS skuMappingId, project_map.project_id AS projectId, session_map.session_id AS sessionId, sku_map.sku_id AS skuId, project_map.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, session_map.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, sku_map.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, project_map.auto_publish_enabled AS autoPublishEnabled, local_sku.stock_locked AS stockLocked, local_sku.stock_available AS stockAvailable FROM ticket_source_project_mapping project_map JOIN ticket_source_provider provider ON provider.provider_id = project_map.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping session_map ON session_map.project_mapping_id = project_map.mapping_id AND session_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map ON sku_map.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE project_map.provider_id = #{providerId} AND project_map.provider_project_id = #{providerProjectId} AND project_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' ORDER BY session_map.mapping_id ASC, sku_map.mapping_id ASC

SELECT provider.provider_id AS providerId, provider.provider_code AS providerCode, project_map.mapping_id AS projectMappingId, session_map.mapping_id AS sessionMappingId, sku_map.mapping_id AS skuMappingId, project_map.project_id AS projectId, session_map.session_id AS sessionId, sku_map.sku_id AS skuId, project_map.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, session_map.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, sku_map.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, project_map.auto_publish_enabled AS autoPublishEnabled, local_sku.stock_locked AS stockLocked, local_sku.stock_available AS stockAvailable FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping session_map ON session_map.mapping_id = sku_map.session_mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping project_map ON project_map.mapping_id = session_map.project_mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_provider provider ON provider.provider_id = project_map.provider_id JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE project_map.provider_id = #{providerId} AND sku_map.provider_sku_id = #{providerSkuId} AND project_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' AND session_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' LIMIT 1

SELECT sku_status FROM ticket_sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE ticket_sku local_sku JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map ON sku_map.sku_id = local_sku.sku_id JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping session_map ON session_map.mapping_id = sku_map.session_mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping project_map ON project_map.mapping_id = session_map.project_mapping_id SET local_sku.sku_status = CASE WHEN project_map.mapping_status != 'BOUND' OR session_map.mapping_status != 'BOUND' OR sku_map.mapping_status != 'BOUND' THEN 'OFFLINE' WHEN sku_map.source_sale_status IN ('OFF_SHELF', 'ENDED', 'UNKNOWN') THEN 'OFFLINE' WHEN sku_map.source_sale_status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN 'SOLD_OUT'
WHEN sku_map.available_stock_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND local_sku.stock_available <= 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' WHEN sku_map.source_sale_status = 'PRESALE' THEN 'PRESALE' WHEN sku_map.source_sale_status = 'ON_SALE' THEN 'ON_SALE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END, local_sku.update_time = NOW() WHERE project_map.mapping_id = #{projectMappingId}

UPDATE performance_session local_session JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping session_map ON session_map.session_id = local_session.session_id JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping project_map ON project_map.mapping_id = session_map.project_mapping_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_map.session_mapping_id, MAX(CASE WHEN local_sku.sku_status = 'ON_SALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_on_sale, MAX(CASE WHEN local_sku.sku_status = 'PRESALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_presale, MAX(CASE WHEN local_sku.sku_status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_sold_out FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' GROUP BY sku_map.session_mapping_id ) sku_state ON sku_state.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id SET local_session.session_status = CASE WHEN project_map.mapping_status != 'BOUND' OR session_map.mapping_status != 'BOUND' THEN 'OFFLINE' WHEN session_map.source_sale_status = 'ENDED' THEN 'ENDED' WHEN session_map.source_sale_status IN ('OFF_SHELF', 'UNKNOWN') THEN 'OFFLINE' WHEN COALESCE(sku_state.has_on_sale, 0) = 1 THEN 'ON_SALE' WHEN COALESCE(sku_state.has_presale, 0) = 1 THEN 'PRESALE' WHEN COALESCE(sku_state.has_sold_out, 0) = 1 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END, local_session.update_time = NOW() WHERE project_map.mapping_id = #{projectMappingId}

UPDATE performance_session local_session JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping session_map ON session_map.session_id = local_session.session_id SET local_session.min_price = ( SELECT MIN(local_sku.price) FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE sku_map.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' ), local_session.max_price = ( SELECT MAX(local_sku.price) FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE sku_map.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' ), local_session.update_time = NOW() WHERE session_map.project_mapping_id = #{projectMappingId}

UPDATE performance_project local_project JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping project_map ON project_map.project_id = local_project.project_id SET local_project.min_price = ( SELECT MIN(local_sku.price) FROM ticket_source_session_mapping session_map JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map ON sku_map.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE session_map.project_mapping_id = project_map.mapping_id AND session_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' ), local_project.max_price = ( SELECT MAX(local_sku.price) FROM ticket_source_session_mapping session_map JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping sku_map ON sku_map.session_mapping_id = session_map.mapping_id JOIN ticket_sku local_sku ON local_sku.sku_id = sku_map.sku_id WHERE session_map.project_mapping_id = project_map.mapping_id AND session_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' AND sku_map.mapping_status = 'BOUND' ), local_project.update_time = NOW() WHERE project_map.mapping_id = #{projectMappingId}
